blockers.detail: The final DeepSeek qualification group produced two frozen Blueprints and one output-limit truncation; the required threshold is 3/3.
The two successful qualification artifacts predate selection-receipt propagation through ProductionGenerationClient; the source fix is tested but the strict gate forbids extra live reruns after 2/3.
The API Lab gateway must defer structured selection to CGKN to preserve one selector authority; the audited local API Lab patch remains outside this repository and uncommitted.
No verified pricing snapshot was needed because Phase 2 was not entered.
